title: MAINT: USB endpoint sentinel 0 is undocumented implicit invariant
description: wp11_ccid_open() uses ep_in=0 and ep_out=0 as 'not found' sentinels, then rejects with WP11_CCID_ERR_NOTFOUND if either is 0. USB bulk endpoints always have non-zero addresses (0 is the control endpoint). This assumption is correct but undocumented. Fix: add a comment above the check explaining that CCID bulk endpoints must be non-zero per USB spec, so 0 is a safe sentinel. Alternatively define USB_ENDPOINT_UNSET 0 and USB_CLASS_CCID 0x0B as named constants. Add USB_ENDPOINT_IN_BIT 0x80 constant.
